run_meta_loss: run the meta learning loss function with network parameters, counterfactual values, and unrolling steps
get_network_output: get a softmax policy from a Haiku neural network output masked for illegal actions
get_network_output_batched: get batched softmax policies from a Haiku neural network output masked for illegal actions per sample
mask_cfvalues: mask counterfactual values by zeroing illegal actions and keeping legal action values
get_batched_input: extend input lists to a batch-size-consistent size by sampling with replacement
